title: feat(automation)!: a flow that runs after a record change may not retry an inline outbound call
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgFjcJaYrMtmbGdP6h8htE7F)_

domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaP1iy4RSEQbW6177G

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：记录保存后触发的流程里，凡是会被重试的内联外呼（`http` 未设 `durable`、`connector_action`）在发布时被拒，提示改 `durable: true`（连接器则去掉重试）；引擎注册、元数据保存门（422）、`os validate` 三处同一口径。
- 为什么改：保存要等 after 流程跑完，外部系统宕机时重试阶梯会把用户的保存拖住（QA 实测 8.8 秒）。裁决 D（6810500711）。
- 风险与回滚：收窄（BREAKING，标题带 !）：已存的此类流程启动时被拒、读为 refused；showcase 实测命中两条，已同 PR 改好。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-registration-checks.ts` 的 `validateAfterSaveInlineRetry`，再看 `packages/lint/src/lint-flow-patterns.ts` 的 `scanAfterSaveInlineRetry`，最后 `examples/app-showcase/src/automation/flows/index.ts` 两条流程。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/flow-registration-checks.test.ts`，预期 23 个全绿（本卡新增 13 个：10 个拒收、3 个对照）。
- 需要你做的：无。非受管面、≤3000 行的收窄由席位在契约复审 PASS 后落地；裁决 D 的过渡项「缩短默认重试阶梯」实测无对象（`maxRetries` 默认就是 0），见下文。

Fixes #32161

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — the engine's flow registration, `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint` and the flow live save and publish doors refuse a flow they accepted before.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up owed — #32525 (skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md, its `http` and `try_catch` rows); taught here in content/docs/automation/flows.mdx (Try / catch / retry) and in `os explain flow-after-save-inline-retry`.

## What changes

Ruling 6810500711 (letter D, maintainer verbatim 「同意」): in a flow that runs after a record change, an inline outbound call that is retried is refused at publish, with the fix `durable: true`.

**Step 0, measured on `origin/main` c110853e.**
- The save waits: the record-change trigger's hook handler awaits the run.
- What retries a node inline: a `try_catch` whose `retry.maxRetries` is at least 1 (its `try` region, at any depth) and the flow's `errorHandling.strategy: 'retry'` (`retryExecution` re-runs the whole flow). A descriptor's `supportsRetry` is read by nothing.
- Which builtin nodes call out inline: `http` (unless `config.durable: true`, which queues the request on the messaging HTTP outbox) and `connector_action` (the connector's handler runs inline; it has no background path). `notify` hands its deliveries to the messaging service, which queues them on its own outbox, and has no author switch, so it is not judged. `approval` and `subflow` make no outside call.
- Trigger tokens judged: `record-after-create`, `-insert`, `-update`, `-delete`, `-write` (the record-change trigger's grammar, after-phase only).

**Engine (`service-automation`).** `validateAfterSaveInlineRetry` joins `registrationChecks`, beside `validateStartNode`. One refusal per flow lists every offending node with what retries it and the node type's fix. It covers `POST /api/v1/automation` and the clone door (`registerAndSaveFlow` answers a `registerFlow` throw as a 4xx) and the boot bind: a row stored before this release is refused at boot and reads `registration: refused` beside its stored body (the #23316 path), and the kernel still runs.

**Lint (`@objectstack/lint`).** `flow-after-save-inline-retry` (severity `error`) in the gating `lintFlowPatterns` rule, with an `os explain` entry and the exported id `FLOW_AFTER_SAVE_INLINE_RETRY`. That reaches the metadata save door: a live save or publish answers `422 INVALID_METADATA` with the rule in `issues[]`, and a draft still stores with the finding in `_diagnostics`. The same rule fails `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint`. The `packages/lint/**` surface was added to the claim by the seat for this.

**Showcase.** `objectstack validate` with the new rule flags exactly two flows (measured; `app-crm` and `app-todo` are clean):
- `showcase_project_escalation`: the incident push gets `durable: true`, and the `try_catch` drops its `retry` (the outbox retries; the catch region now reports a request that could not be queued).
- `showcase_resilient_sync`: runs on demand (inputs `taskId`, `title`) instead of after the task save, so it keeps demonstrating try/catch/retry and stays the deterministic handled-failure fixture of the P1 checklist item `automation.flow-error-handling`.

**Checklist and docs.** Three sentences in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/automation.json` that this makes false are corrected, each item's revision bumped with a history row: the record-change chain no longer lists `showcase_resilient_sync`; `automation.flow-error-handling` steps[1] fires it on demand; `automation.trigger-status-contract` steps[2]'s reason for not using it as the success probe is re-worded. `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx` gains one paragraph under Try / catch / retry, and the rule matrix in `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` gains the rule's row (after the docs drift check).

**Disproved premise (declared, not implemented).** The ruling's interim "a shorter default retry ladder for inline http" has nothing to shorten: the retry policy's `maxRetries` defaults to 0 (`packages/spec/src/shared/retry-policy.zod.ts`, `retryPolicyShape`), and an `http` node has no retry of its own. The 8.8 s ladder was authored explicitly in the showcase flow. The default lives in `packages/spec` (out of this claim) and has no inline-retry case left to serve after this refusal. Agreed with the seat.

## Tests

- `flow-registration-checks.test.ts`: a new top-level describe, 13 tests at `217d1e88` (10 at `2b837641`, where the red-first and ablation figures below were taken). Ten refusals: one per after-phase token (`it.each`, five tokens), the flow-level retry, `connector_action` with its own fix, a token with a trailing blank, a `catch` region under a flow-level retry, a node nested in a loop inside the retried `try`. Three controls: `durable: true`; not retried (`maxRetries: 0`, no retry, a node in the `catch` region); a before-trigger, a scheduled and a manual flow.
- `flow-refused-registration-read.integration.test.ts`: a new top-level describe on the real composition: a stored row refused at the boot bind and read as refused; the metadata save door's 422 with the rule and the draft with the finding; control, the durable flow saves and is armed.
- `lint-flow-patterns.test.ts`: a new top-level describe mirroring the engine cases, plus the gating-rule reach and the explain entry.

## Acceptance notes

- A `subflow` node's callee is not walked: it is another flow, registered on its own, and judging it here would read a flow registry that may still be filling at boot. An after-save flow that calls a subflow whose own inline call is retried still holds the save; the callee carries no trigger, so neither judge sees it. Filed as #32526.
- An inline call nothing retries is unaffected by design (the ruling refuses the ladder, not the call). It still holds the save for one call; an inline `http` node with no `timeoutMs` has no timeout of its own.
- A plugin node type that calls out is not judged: only the two builtins are known to call out.
- `durable: true` with no messaging HTTP outbox wired falls back to an inline call (the node's existing behaviour, logged); it is accepted, as the ruling says. The residue is #32526.

## Verification

All local runs on the branch head before the merge of `origin/main` (5db96a94), the touched surfaces unchanged by that merge (it brought `docs/adr`, `scripts/pm` and `ui/` only).

<details><summary>Red first on main, green on the branch, ablation once</summary>

- Red: the new engine cases against `origin/main`'s `flow-registration-checks.ts` (restored unstaged from c110853e, then restored from HEAD): 7 failed (every refusal case), 13 passed (the 3 new controls and the file's 10 earlier tests).
- Green: `flow-registration-checks.test.ts` 20/20; `flow-refused-registration-read.integration.test.ts` 10/10.
- Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor `if (fix && !durable && retriedBy) {` hit once, blob 0f82c217 to a630bbd4, restored to 0f82c217 = HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty): 7 failed (every refusal case), 13 passed. The tests import the source, so no build leg.
</details>

<details><summary>Suites, typechecks, validate</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: 199 files, 8475 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation test`: 277 files, 3769 tests passed.
- Showcase: `vitest run` 48 files, 545 tests passed; `objectstack validate` exit 0 (exit 1 with the two flows above before their change).
- `typecheck`: service-automation, lint and example-showcase, exit 0.
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 102 families; every one run, exit codes captured before any pipe. Three first exited 3 (prerequisite not met: a shallow clone's fixture commit, the client packages unbuilt, a package `dist` missing) and passed once the prerequisite was met. `--ran`: 102 derived, 102 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
</details>

Dogfood battery (owed by the `(narrowing)` arm), on db867ac9c (the head before the docs-only matrix row): `os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0`; Test Files 451 passed, 3 skipped (454); Tests 3775 passed, 42 skipped (3817); no failure.
